entry.description: An event buffered without `Properties` in its `Fix` no longer shows the context properties of the thread that flushes the buffer to `%property`, `%mdc`, `%ndc`, the XML layouts and property filters. Read after the logging call, or on another thread, its properties hold only the event's own and the global ones, and a later fix there stores just these. `FixFlags.Mdc` and `FixFlags.Ndc` now fix the properties, as their names suggest. Behaviour change: once the logging call has returned, and after a fix without `Properties` outside a logging call, the logging thread itself no longer sees its context properties in the event (ANT-2026-FE7I6RPI, fixed by @FreeAndNil)
